scenarios.body: New helper `below_limit(value)` in `app/canary.py`: true when `value` is strictly below `CANARY_LIMIT`, so the limit itself is not below the limit. The comparison in `within_limit` is tidied; its behaviour is unchanged.

return value < CANARY_LIMIT


def below_limit(value: int) -> bool:
    """True when `value` is strictly below the limit. The limit itself is not below it."""
    return value < CANARY_LIMIT
